reason: I already got breached once; I am not handing a random startup my email, let alone an address or phone, just to browse listings you admit are unverified. I know the breach I'm looking up — I'll search the official notice myself.
objection: How do you even know I qualify? And why would I make an account with you when I still have to file on the administrator's site anyway?
would_change_my_mind: Let me look up my named breach with zero signup and land on the official claims page — no email, no phone, no address.
